title: Camtek Ltd. SEC EDGAR annual reports on Form 20-F
license_notes: Numeric values and short evidence passages only; original EDGAR HTML filings held locally under the maintainer's local archive (not distributed): Financial reports/Camtek filings/, downloaded directly from SEC EDGAR (www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1109138/) with a descriptive User-Agent, sha256-hashed locally. Both are the full Form 20-F annual report as filed (HTML, not PDF): camtek_20f_fy2025.htm (filed 2026-03-19, covers fiscal years 2025/2024/2023) and camtek_20f_fy2023.htm (filed 2024-03-21, covers fiscal years 2023/2022/2021), registered locator_kind html with page_count 1 per the atlas's established HTML pattern (see data/sources/smee.json) -- the automated check-pages page check does not reach HTML sources (registered_source_not_pdf), so every row's excerpt was read and transcribed directly against the live downloaded file.
